notes: BUB1B compound heterozygous - Mosaic Variegated Aneuploidy type 1 (MIM 257300, AR). Allele 1 c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter (rs759242053, gnomAD 7.9e-05) nonsense in exon 17/23 - PTC predicted to trigger NMD, null allele. Allele 2 c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys, absent from gnomAD, last exon (23/23, escapes NMD), within the kinase domain; deleterious by SIFT, probably_damaging by PolyPhen, likely_pathogenic by AlphaMissense. Null + hypomorph is the canonical MVA1 allelic architecture (biallelic null is embryonic lethal). Phenotype match: rhabdomyosarcoma is the signature malignancy of BUB1B-MVA; IUGR, short stature and parental recurrent miscarriage complete the cluster. Phase in trans inferred, not proven (10.9 kb apart, no parental data).
Allele 1 reported individually in case ground truth is encoded per-variant rather than as a pair. BUB1B NM_001211.6 c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter. GT 0/1, DP 46, AD 21/25, GQ 99, MQ 60, PASS.
Allele 2 reported individually in case ground truth is encoded per-variant rather than as a pair. BUB1B NM_001211.6 c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys. GT 0/1, DP 28, AD 15/13, GQ 99, MQ 60, PASS.

ATM NM_000051.4 c.2932T>C p.Ser978Pro (rs139552233), heterozygous VUS. Reported here only for completeness of the cancer-predisposition review; gnomAD AF 0.5% is too common for a pathogenic ATM allele and monoallelic ATM does not explain the proband phenotype. Not considered contributory.

MAD1L1 NM_003550.3 c.175C>T p.Arg59Cys (rs121908982), heterozygous. Same mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint pathway as BUB1B, hence surfaced, but gnomAD AF 0.57% and SIFT tolerated; monoallelic and not a credible second driver. Not considered contributory.
